predict.question: Eight class-A events are not targets; two class-B events are targets. When both classes are included, what share are targets?

exploreHint: Compare both named cases; keep each result for the reveal.
bookIdea: The Invisible Gorilla discusses limits on awareness when attention is directed toward another task.
modelBoundary: Counting A alone includes {A}% targets; counting both includes {B}%. Adding class B changes both target count and denominator.
doesItHoldUp: Does it hold up? This selection rule is not a human attention experiment or an estimate of inattentional blindness.
